tei:div.tei:p: bdag nyid skad cig gis rdo rje he ru ka mthing nag mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis g.yas gsum rdo rje bhan dmar dgra st+wa/ g.yon gsum dril bu thod khrag thong gshol 'dzin pa/ zhabs bzhi g.yon brkyang ba'i 'dor stabs can dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ yum rdo rje khrag 'thung ma sngon mo dung dmar stob pa'i tshul gyis yab la 'khyud pa/ cher gtum zhing khros pa'i nyams can ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku las khro tshogs mtshon cha'i tshwa tshwa 'phros pas bdud bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad bsdig bskrad brlag par gyur/
